name: Joseph Tang
bio: I am an undergraduate at Southeast University majoring in Information Engineering. My research focuses on electromagnetics and photonics, sensor technologies and near-field sensing, and machine learning for physical systems. I am interested in combining computational design with experimental measurements to develop more capable sensing and wave-control devices.
experience_bio: Before joining the LEAP laboratory at EPFL as a visiting student, I was an exchange student and research assistant at the University of California, Berkeley in 2025, working in the Liwei Lin Lab.
